entries.title: 6 month neurosis problem solver
entries.desc: I made this early!! It's Friday the 6th of July... around 7 A.M. I have a OCD thing for patterns... and I broke the previous 6 months of trying to make a beat every week ... because i was being neurotic about it! And I really want to fill the solid 6 month block for the remainder of this year.. And so after a bit of reflection I came to the conclusion that the obvious solution is to WRITE THE BEAT BEFORE DEADLINE (NOT THE NIGHT BEFORE) So officially, Friday (Or Wednesday is my new precieved deadline) I hope this is the begining of my horrible procrastination ways of the second half of 2012. Happy Winter Solstice everyone... I wrote this druing the friday morning sunrise off my balcony, freezing cold.. near my plants... 'I have frequently seen people become neurotic when they content themselves with inadequate or wrong answers to the questions of life (Jung, [1961] 1989:140).'

entries.title: Chillstep?
entries.desc: I don't think I've spent this long in one session writing a complete track for quite some time now, feels good. Hope this turns out ok. I think I loose a lot of the production when I mix things down and master it in audacity, things get lost.. Made the piano bit by hand, no quantize (except cleaned up velocity's and start points on a few here and there) Who cares? well, I usually Q-Rec.... meh I dunno, I do know if I didn't have work tomorrow I'd probably keep messing with this for another few hours... but run the risk of potentially breaking it somehow. So I think I'll mark this, COMPLETE for week 30! ... yay! I wish I made it longer... meh Update Edit: I made this track longer! Released on Soundcloud - http://soundcloud.com/adaynetau/diving-into-a-fractal
